data.name: Boston Harbor Lighthouse Cruise
data.headline: Boston's only lighthouse tour with the United States Coast Guard and National Park Service |All Ages
data.description:
Tour Highlights:

This special narrated cruise voyages through maritime history and passes renowned Boston Harbor landmarks and three-lighthouses of Boston Harbor. This 2-hour cruise will sail past Long Island Light, Graves Light, and Boston Light, America's oldest light station. Narrations and programs on-board provided by staff and volunteers from the National Park Service and United States Coast Guard. ​

As we approach the 250th anniversary of our nation's founding, we are debuting a new Lighthouse Cruise. The 1:00pm Saturday Lighthouse Cruises will focus on the Siege of Boston and its impact on Boston Harbor while continuing to share the history of Boston Light, Long Island Head Light, and Graves Light.

Please Note

- There is no public access to Little Brewster or Boston Light.
- Adverse weather conditions can force cancellations. Please check your email and voicemail before your trip. ​
- There is no food or water available on the boat. - Feel free to bring your own snacks and meals.
- Alcohol, smoking and vaping are prohibited on the boat.
data.what_is_included: - 2-hour cruise will sail past Long Island Light, Graves Light, and Boston Light, America's oldest light station. Narrations and programs on-board provided by staff and volunteers from the National Park Service and United States Coast Guard. ​
data.what_is_not_included:
There is no public access to Little Brewster Island or Boston Light due to ongoing maintenance following winter storms. Weather and sea conditions can occasionally force cancellations. Please check your email or voicemail before arriving for your trip.

Food and water are not available on the boat. Plan to bring your own food and drink. Alcoholic beverages, smoking, and vaping are not permitted on the cruise.
data.cancellation_notes:
#Cancellation policy
Boston Light tickets are non-refundable 12 hours after purchase. If in the case of unsafe seas or reasons determined by the US Coast Guard or captain, visitor will be fully refunded or given the option to reschedule.

Trips run rain or shine, please plan accordingly.
data.booking_notes:
#Check-In Information
>All tours depart from the Boston Harbor Island Welcome Center on the Rose Kennedy Greenway at 191w Atlantic Avenue, Boston, MA 02110, directly across from the Long Wharf Marriott, Quincy Market and Aquarium MBTA Stop. Please arrive at least 30 minutes prior to your departure time, tours WILL NOT wait for tardy individuals. If you arrive less than 15 minutes before your tour, you will not be able to board.
> The Boston Waterfront, is convenient to public transportation. The Aquarium Station lets out across the street from the Welcome Center.  South Station (on the Red Line and Commuter Rail) is a short walk (20 min). There are several parking lots nearby and are within a 5-10 minute walk; fees vary. 

Boston traffic can be very congested, please plan accordingly.
